lines.text: A son. A father. A husband. A man who stopped speaking.
lines.context: Eavesdropper, the guardian of the first gate. A dry, close, whispering voice that has heard everything. Scene: The First Gate.

lines.text: Called by name. I listen for you now.
lines.context: Eavesdropper, the guardian of the first gate. A dry, close, whispering voice that has heard everything. Scene: The First Gate.
